title: Chapter 127 The Bandit Is Caught
content:
Chapter 127 The Bandit Is Caught

300 gold coins is not a small amount. It seems that other villages have also been exploited by Qingmu Village.

However, these bandits have hit a wall this time.

Seeing that the other party was alert, Wang Shuo stopped talking nonsense.

"Go ahead and take them down."

With Gong Zheng and Li Jianguo, plus Wang Shuo, it was more than enough to deal with a few small bandits.

Wang Shuo took out the flaming gun directly, and the red flame armor covered his whole body, and the nine-dragon gold pattern wrapped his head tightly.

The long gun crossed the ground, leaving a long groove.

When he was about to get close to the bandit leader, Wang Shuo swung his arm, and the tip of the flaming gun rubbed sparks on the gravel on the ground.

The bandit leader had no idea that the other party was still smiling in the last second, and then launched a fierce attack in the next second.

He only saw a gun head in his eyes, which gradually became larger from far to near, and stabbed his face directly.

Without time to say more, he hurriedly retreated, trying to avoid the shot.

But Wang Shuo would not give him a chance and followed quickly.

As the bandit leader retreated, he was tripped by a stone.

Wang Shuo immediately seized the opportunity, jumped into the air, and stabbed down suddenly.

The bandit leader immediately took out a wooden shield from his backpack, trying to block Wang Shuo's attack.

Unfortunately, he completely underestimated Wang Shuo's strength and ignored the sharpness of the golden spear.

"Puchi."

The spear pierced the shield without any hindrance and directly pierced the chest of the bandit leader.

The worn leather armor on the bandit leader was pierced immediately, and the spear pierced into his chest, four fingers deep.

"-206"

A huge red number floated above his head.

The bandit leader was terrified and begged for mercy: "Wait a minute, we don't need the protection fee."

"It's too late." Wang Shuo slashed with his spear, directly pulling a huge gash in his chest.

Blood kept flowing.

How could he let others sleep peacefully beside his bed!

Qingmu Village in Wadang Mountain was so close to Wana Village, Wang Shuo could never tolerate the existence of this group of bandits.

When he was free, Wang Shuo planned to lead his troops to flatten the village.

Today, these little bandits are just appetizers!

Although the bandit leader's fighting skills and level equipment were far behind Wang Shuo.

But his health value was also more than 2,000, so Wang Shuo was not able to kill him with one blow.

The bandit leader used a big knife to deflect Wang Shuo's spear, gaining a short gap, and he immediately turned over and stood up.

The two continued to fight.

However, the bandit leader was in danger, while Wang Shuo was strolling leisurely.

After many battles, Wang Shuo's "Dragon Spear Art" is about to be upgraded.

He is more and more adept at using the spear.

After a few rounds, the bandit leader's health has been reduced to 200 points.

"Don't fight, I surrender, I surrender." The bandit leader, with a sad face, immediately retreated, knelt on one knee, raised his hands, but did not throw away the big knife in his hand.

Wang Shuo heard the other party surrender and did not attack again.

The bandit leader breathed a sigh of relief.

"Put down your weapons, raise your hands above your head, and squat on the ground." Wang Shuo shouted loudly.

At this time, the other four small bandits saw that the situation was not right, and two of them turned around and ran.

"Watch this man." Wang Shuo said to the people around him, and then summoned a warhorse to chase the fleeing bandits.

Not long after, the two bandits were caught by Wang Shuo.

"What a bunch of poor guys, they don't even have a horse."

The bandit leader saw his brothers being captured and felt as if he was dead.

Barbie Q!

Now there is no one left to report back.

Tie him up first and interrogate him later.

When Wang Shuo was arresting the bandits, he did not notice that there was a figure hiding behind a stone in the distance, which Wang Shuo did not find.

And he was not a bandit.

When Wang Shuo returned to the village, he secretly observed for a while, then retreated silently and disappeared in the north.
